dialogues.speaker: Hussaina
dialogues.text: Brrr, this blasted place is so cold! If I'd known it'd be this bad, I'd have brought some extra clothes. This is all your fault, Samir. Why'd you wanna travel here anyway...

dialogues.speaker: Samir
dialogues.text: Geh... I didn't know it was so cold here either. Also, extra clothes, you say...

dialogues.speaker: Samir
dialogues.text: I don't even think ten extra sets of outerwear would save us here.

dialogues.speaker: Hussaina
dialogues.text: Why... Why don't we try some of the Fire-Water they've got here? Just a sip might warm us up, you never know.

dialogues.speaker: Samir
dialogues.text: Are you forgetting how you wound up leaping atop a table at Lambad's and singing your heart out after just a sip of low-proof alcohol?

dialogues.speaker: Hussaina
dialogues.text: You keep saying that, but I don't remember ever doing that...

dialogues.speaker: Samir
dialogues.text: That's because you'd completely zonked out by that point! Whatever. You know what? Forget the Fire-Water. Let's shop around for thicker clothes later, alright, friend?

dialogues.speaker: Hussaina
dialogues.text: ...Can't we at least have a bit?

dialogues.speaker: Samir
dialogues.text: Ah ha! I knew it! You just wanted to drink! No. Absolutely not!
